en: Color photograph of a large neo‑Romanesque church with two tall, slender twin towers topped by steep slate roofs and spires. The façade has multiple arched windows, decorative arcades, and a large circular rose window above three entrance portals, one of which includes a colored tympanum depicting religious figures. The church is built of light stone with reddish bands. Trees and a small park or square are visible in the foreground under a clear blue sky.
